claims.claim: One VPS (Hetzner or DigitalOcean, 2–4 GB RAM) is plenty for 20,000 subscribers
claims.about: Self-hosted Ghost (Node.js) on a single VPS
claims.why: Ghost was not benchmarked, and the closest server, node-express, only shows simple endpoints using 55–75 MB peak memory and a few thousand to about 17,600 requests/s; that says nothing about Ghost's memory use or what a 20,000-subscriber newsletter needs.
